//: lib is pinned to ES2023 with no DOM on purpose. TypeScript includes DOM by default when lib is unset, so until this line existed a Lambda could reference document or window and typecheck clean -- verified by planting document.title in src/lambda/capture.ts. This config covers the Lambdas, the CDK app and the Node scripts; JSX files are excluded and covered by tsconfig.app.json, which pnpm typecheck also runs.
